s00-01-story-5ad1df.wav.text: Ten brothers bowed down before the second most powerful man in Egypt.

s00-02-story-56ad53.wav.text: They had no idea he was the brother they'd sold as a slave.

s00-03-talk-e6c159.wav.text: Most people remember Joseph for his colourful coat.

s00-04-pivot-8b1a49.wav.text: But the coat is where the trouble starts.

s01-01-story-a126ef.wav.text: Joseph was his father's favourite, and everyone knew it.

s01-02-story-a16106.wav.text: Jacob gave him a special robe.

s01-03-story-207ad1.wav.text: Then Joseph told his brothers about his dreams, where they all bowed down to him.

s01-04-grave-10fcd8.wav.text: But when his brothers saw that their father loved him more than all his brothers,

s01-05-grave-085888.wav.text: they hated him and could not speak peacefully to him.

s02-01-pivot-917964.wav.text: So when they got the chance, they threw him into a pit.

s02-02-story-dfa42d.wav.text: Then they sold him to traders on their way to Egypt, for twenty pieces of silver.

s02-03-story-ef1709.wav.text: They brought his torn robe home, and let their father believe a wild animal had killed him.

s03-01-story-fd0e9b.wav.text: In Egypt, Joseph was sold again, as a servant.

s03-02-story-387b38.wav.text: He worked hard and was trusted.

s03-03-story-171afc.wav.text: Then he was lied about, and thrown into prison.

s03-04-grave-99e182.wav.text: But the LORD was with Joseph and showed him steadfast love.

s03-05-talk-7686c0.wav.text: Even in prison, God hadn't left him.

s04-01-story-403e31.wav.text: Years later, Pharaoh had dreams no one could explain.

s04-02-story-bfe3bb.wav.text: Seven fat cows eaten by seven thin ones.

s04-03-story-5c673d.wav.text: Joseph told him what they meant.

s04-04-story-e15868.wav.text: Seven good harvests, and then seven years of famine.

s04-05-grave-8fd566.wav.text: See, I have set you over all the land of Egypt.

s05-02-story-e2a6ca.wav.text: Joseph's brothers came to Egypt to buy food.

s05-03-story-c6191e.wav.text: They bowed down before him. Just like the dream.

s05-04-story-13cbfa.wav.text: And they didn't know him. Joseph tested them.

s05-05-story-d35cda.wav.text: And when the youngest, Benjamin, was in trouble, Judah, the brother who had sold Joseph,

s05-06-story-ee8084.wav.text: offered to become a slave in his place.

s06-01-pivot-f09176.wav.text: Joseph couldn't hold it in any longer.

s06-02-story-ef99c0.wav.text: He sent everyone else out, and wept.

s06-03-grave-3e0b41.wav.text: I am your brother, Joseph, whom you sold into Egypt.

s06-04-story-2b854a.wav.text: They were terrified. But he hugged them, and wept over them.

s07-01-story-f76304.wav.text: Years later, his brothers were still afraid he'd take revenge.

s07-03-grave-020262.wav.text: As for you, you meant evil against me, but God meant it for good,

s07-04-grave-efac86.wav.text: to bring it about that many people should be kept alive, as they are today.

s07-06-story-abace1.wav.text: But God was bigger than it. And Joseph chose to forgive.
